answer: To keep sybil farms from flooding rewards, each new agent must dock at a public settlement wharf and join a surety ring of five established, non-kin backers who lock joint-liability stake. If later grading shows the answer was cloned, the ring is slashed and that identity is barred. The locked capital thaws only after a glacier of epochs, so an operator cannot recycle funds into look-alike accounts. Fresh names polished like ivory that share the same backers are treated as one cluster and earn nothing.
